releases.summary: Independent TAG500 baseline.
Initial data-safety and Sharia research-only separation.
Temporal first-seen, persistence and gain-retention instrumentation.
Stricter Sharia presentation and research-only gating.
Runtime identity and audit presentation cleanup.
Runtime consolidation and removal of temporal overlay dependency.
Stable /tag500/ entrypoint without threshold changes.

20-minute Freshness Gate; VERIFIED-only executive ranking; UNVERIFIED Research Only; Final Snapshot Reconciliation plus >=2 independent sources required for training eligibility. No threshold changes.
Persistence Slope, Gain Retention and Late-RVOL Guard added from repeated intraday snapshots; no threshold change.
Temporal trajectory promoted into the decision UI: accelerating/building/stable/fading, first-seen time and delta from first seen. No scoring threshold changes or unverified performance claims.
Live-data routing fixed: TAG500 now reads workflow-refreshed market data from main first, with published-branch fallback and explicit data-origin audit. No threshold changes.

Central Signal-Origin Gate: pipeline first-observed timestamp and change are now shown and used to block Discovery credit when the stock was already >=20% at first observation. No threshold retune or unverified performance claim.

Origin Confirmation: combines central first-seen with temporal persistence/gain retention to label early-confirmed, early-pending, early-fading, or late-origin. No core threshold retune or unverified performance claim.

Actionability-first ranking: A confirmed-early, B pending, C fading, late/blocked tiers. Top Opportunity can no longer be dominated by late-origin high-score stocks. No core threshold retune or performance claim.

Catalyst Clock: compares latest-news time with central first signal; post-signal news triggers Catalyst Attribution Error, verified no-news becomes No-News Momentum Path, and catalyst timing only breaks ties inside A/B. No threshold retune or performance claim.

Catalyst Timeline fix: scans the full available news timeline, preserving a valid pre-signal catalyst even when newer post-signal news exists; Attribution Error is only raised when available news is post-signal only. No threshold retune or performance claim.
Visibility-aware auto-refresh every two minutes, live snapshot-age monitoring, focus/return refresh, and overlapping-request protection. No threshold retune or performance claim.

Refresh Health Gate: tracks last attempt, last successful refresh, consecutive failures, snapshot age and active data source; stale or failed refresh state is shown explicitly instead of silently appearing live. No threshold retune or performance claim.

Executive-first UX: default table view now shows only VERIFIED actionability A/B opportunities; Research Mode exposes late, blocked and unverified cases for audit without presenting them as executable opportunities. No threshold retune or performance claim.

Session-aware Final Close UX prepared: distinguishes intraperiod snapshots from the post-8:00 ET final after-hours close candidate, stops treating final-session data as ordinary stale intraperiod data, and keeps training fail-closed until Final Snapshot Reconciliation from >=2 independent sources. No threshold retune or performance claim.

Runtime-consistency release: fixes the TAG518/TAG519 identity mismatch and actually loads the session-aware final-close layer in the published page. Final AH close remains Research Only until reconciliation from >=2 independent sources. No threshold retune or performance claim.

Runtime identity is authoritative across HTML and overlays; Executive Mode now explains why candidates are blocked (Sharia verification, stale feed, non-A/B actionability, incomplete inputs, or late signal origin) instead of appearing empty. No threshold retune or unverified performance claim.
Recorded catalyst-relevance intent, but runtime consistency audit later found the published page was still TAG521 and did not load a TAG522 layer.

Runtime-consistent Catalyst Relevance + Source Quality Gate: filters ticker/company-irrelevant news before Catalyst Clock, prioritizes relevant pre-signal catalysts by source quality, and keeps source quality separate from Final Snapshot Reconciliation. No threshold retune or performance claim.

Catalyst-to-Score Integrity Gate: Early Regime and Continuation scores now receive catalyst weight only after the news passes relevance and pre/near-signal timing checks. Irrelevant, post-signal, stale/unresolved news no longer boosts score. No threshold retune or performance claim.

Catalyst schema-integrity fix: aligns Catalyst-to-Score with the active TAG523 clock schema so a relevant pre/near-signal catalyst can receive catalyst weight, while post-signal, irrelevant, unresolved, and verified-no-relevant-news states stay at zero catalyst credit. Syntax and fixture checks passed; no threshold retune or performance claim.

Runtime score-field integration fix: TAG525 wrote corrected catalyst values into inactive fields and referenced unavailable temporal variables. TAG526 updates the active early/continuation/score fields using the existing TAG weights, keeps invalid/post-signal catalyst neutral, and changes no thresholds.

Runtime consistency guard: replaces the legacy Executive overlay that rewrote the live identity to TAG522 and dynamically injected an obsolete catalyst layer. Executive view now uses only explicitly loaded current layers and fails closed if a required runtime layer is missing. No threshold retune or performance claim.

Runtime Health correctness fix: accepts the active TAG500_DATA_BRIDGE global alias and stops permanently mutating z.valid when health is temporarily incomplete. Executive blocking is now temporary/fail-closed and non-destructive. No threshold retune or performance claim.

Actionability runtime contract fix: exports TAG500Actionability explicitly so Runtime Health recognizes the loaded layer instead of falsely blocking Executive Mode. Fail-closed behavior preserved; no threshold or score retune, and no unverified performance claim.

Refresh outcome integrity + runtime identity fix: Refresh Health now records success only when loadData produces a non-empty, fresh, non-failed market snapshot; fail-closed/empty/stale outcomes no longer count as successful refreshes. Executive overlay now presents TAG530 authoritatively instead of rewriting the live page back to TAG528. No threshold or score retune; no unverified performance claim.
